portInfo.description: Arendal Havn places its cruise quays in the town centre of this Sørlandet harbour city, historically on seven small islands and often nicknamed the “Venice of the North” in port copy. Technical data for Batterikaien and Hotellkaien include published WGS positions, 110 m / 77 m lengths, 10 m max draught and 2.2 m quay height. The fender system suits vessels up to 80,000 GT and 280 m LOA; ships over 220 m require tug assistance under pilot regulations; bollards tested to SWL 50 t; ISPS-certified. Approach is through Galtesund (~4 nautical miles from the pilot), with a 120 m minimum entrance width between navigation lights. Contact +47 975 27 000 / VHF 12 or 16; post@arendalhavn.no.
